backend: MuJoCo 3.3.7, existing C5 mechanical rotor asset
reference: rotor physically crosses 2 radians, bracketed from stored qpos
effect: flow proxy <=0.005 mL/s continuously for 0.2s, bracketed from stored velocity
rgb_role: recorded native renderer views, not policy input in this component
calibration_assumptions: finite native coast probes at two declared mechanical settings, not a statistical or hardware coverage guarantee
strong_baseline: calibrated_scheduler uses identical duration bounds, privileges and recovery choices
costs: declared transport and controller delays advance plant; measured host work does not advance this simulation
recovery_scope: retry success or retry failure -> feedback wait -> relay -> mechanical decay; conditioned on relay support and calibration
direct_baseline: relay_first has identical permissions; lower complexity ceiling control
control_calibration: same prior native probes, no test-setting parameters available to policy
